# Reverse Tax Calculator (reversetaxcalculator.pro)

> Free, fast, client-side financial web calculators to find pre-tax net prices, tax paid, and tax rates backwards from gross totals.

## Core Purpose & Utility
Reverse Tax Calculator provides instant mathematical answers for users asking "how do I calculate tax backwards from a total." All calculations are performed in client-side JavaScript with zero latency and zero data collection.

## Key Formulas
- **Reverse Tax Formula**: Net Amount = Gross Total ÷ (1 + Tax Rate Decimal)
- **Tax Amount Paid**: Tax Paid = Gross Total - Net Amount
- **Tax Rate Solver**: Tax Rate % = [(Gross Total ÷ Net Amount) - 1] × 100
- **Quebec GST + QST (Additive)**: Net Amount = Gross Total ÷ (1 + 0.05 GST + 0.09975 QST)
- **Reverse Tax & Tip**: Subtotal Net = Total Paid ÷ (1 + Tax Rate + Tip Rate)
- **Net to Gross Paycheck**: Estimated Gross = Target Net ÷ (1 - Effective Tax Rate)
